steps.code:
# Collect all unique songs and artist IDs from all playlists
unique_songs = {}  # song_id -> set of artist_ids
all_artist_ids = set()
for playlist in all_playlists:
    for song in playlist['songs']:
        song_id = song['id']
        artist_ids = set(song['artist_ids'])
        if song_id not in unique_songs:
            unique_songs[song_id] = artist_ids
        else:
            # If same song appears in multiple playlists, we just keep the artist_ids (should be same)
            unique_songs[song_id].update(artist_ids)
        all_artist_ids.update(artist_ids)

print(f"Unique songs: {len(unique_songs)}")
print(f"Unique artists: {len(all_artist_ids)}")
print("Sample song IDs:", list(unique_songs.keys())[:5])
